items.html: And behold, it is known that AVI are HaVaYaH and Ehyeh in Yudin, and HaVaYaH is hidden within Ehyeh, as above; therefore Tzelem is the gematria of Ehyeh of Yudin. For HaVaYaH is hidden within it and is not revealed, and only Ehyeh of Yudin, which is the gematria of Tzelem, is discernible. For it was already said above that this Tzelem comes from the coupling of the upper HB, which are called HaVaYaH and Ehyeh of Yudin, and from there it is drawn; therefore it is called by their name, even though it afterwards clothes in Tevuna 3, whose name is not so, but only the name SAG, as was said.
